target.title: fix(codex): trigger model fallback on usage-limit promptError (#103734)
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

When a Codex-backed turn hits the subscription usage limit, the Codex harness
returns a `promptError` in the attempt result instead of throwing. The host's
model fallback is throw-driven — it only engages when `FailoverError` is
thrown. As a result, the configured fallback model is never tried and the run
fails terminally.

Fixes #103734.

## Why This Change Was Made

Two changes in the embedded agent runner:

1. **`run.ts`**: when `promptError` text matches rate/usage limit patterns
   (`usage limit`, `rate limit`, `quota`, `too many requests`), mark the
   incomplete turn as `fallbackSafe` so the classifier can proceed, and
   preserve the original error text in `meta.error.message`.

2. **`result-fallback-classifier.ts`**: detect rate/usage limit messages in
   `meta.error.message` (before the generic incomplete-turn handler) and
   classify them via the existing `classifyFailoverReason` path as
   `rate_limit`, so the fallback loop switches to the configured fallback.

## User Impact

**Before:** Codex usage limit → terminal failure, fallback model never tried
**After:** Codex usage limit → `rate_limit` failover → falls back to next
configured model (e.g. `anthropic/claude-opus-4-8`)

## Evidence

Branch: `fix/103734-codex-usage-limit-fallback` | Base: `upstream/main`

### Live model proof

Normal agent run completes successfully — the change does not break the
agent execution path:

```
$ pnpm --filter openclaw openclaw agent --local --model zte/Qwen3-235B-A22B --message "say hello in one word" --session-key agent:default:proof-103734

[model-fetch] status=200 model=Qwen3-235B-A22B elapsedMs=5477
hello
[agent] run ended with stopReason=stop
```

### End-to-end classifier proof

Proof script calls `classifyEmbeddedAgentRunResultForModelFallback` — the
exact production classifier — with simulated Codex usage-limit results:

```
$ node --import tsx scripts/proof/codex-usage-limit-fallback.mts

=== #103734 fallback classifier proof ===

Case 1 — usage limit → rate_limit: PASS
Case 2 — rate limit message → rate_limit: PASS
Case 3 — generic message → not rate_limit: PASS
Case 4 — quota exceeded → rate_limit: PASS
Case 5 — non-rate-limit → not rate_limit: PASS

OVERALL: ALL PASSED
```

### Regression tests

```
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/result-fallback-classifier.test.ts

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  20 passed (20)
```

```
oxlint        → 0 errors
git diff --check → clean

```
